context: Evaluates correct implementation of the useLocalStorage hook from visionarias-client. The hook must read from localStorage on initialization, write to localStorage on state updates, serialize/deserialize values as JSON, and gracefully handle SSR environments where window is undefined.

checklist.name: useState initialization
checklist.description: Uses React useState with an initializer function that reads from localStorage, falling back to the provided initialValue when the key is absent

checklist.name: JSON serialization
checklist.description: Stores values using JSON.stringify and retrieves them using JSON.parse, supporting non-string types like objects and arrays

checklist.name: Setter writes to localStorage
checklist.description: The returned setter function both calls the React state setter and calls localStorage.setItem with the serialized value

checklist.name: SSR window guard
checklist.description: Checks for window availability (typeof window !== 'undefined') before accessing localStorage to prevent errors during server-side rendering

checklist.name: useState-compatible signature
checklist.description: Returns a [value, setter] tuple with the same interface as React's useState, typed with a generic parameter <T>
